_help: Instagram posting queue. GitHub publishes each post at its time (India time), within ~15 minutes.
Media files live in site/social/ (they must be live on theartfulproducts.com before the post time).
type: image (1 file) | carousel (2-10 files, images and/or videos) | reel (1 .mp4, 9:16, 3s-15min).
Set "hold": true to keep a post in the queue without publishing it.
Published posts are recorded in social/posted.json - never remove a post from here once published.
